description: Source code for ActivityMonitor plugin in WPEFramework, implementing process monitoring, memory and CPU usage thresholds, and event notifications.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Configuration for individual monitored applications, including thresholds and state.

classes.name: MonitorParams
classes.description: Parameters for monitoring process, including intervals and current configurations.

classes.name: MemoryInfo
classes.description: Utility class for system memory and process information, including CPU usage, memory, and process details.

classes.name: ActivityMonitor
classes.description: Main class implementing process monitoring, threshold detection, and event notification.

methods.name: getApplicationMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage for a specific application process by PID.

methods.name: getAllMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage for all monitored applications.

methods.name: enableMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring specified applications with given thresholds and intervals.

methods.name: monitoring
methods.description: Main loop for periodic process, memory, and CPU monitoring, and event triggering.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Thread entry point for monitoring loop.

methods.name: onMemoryThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Notify event when memory threshold is exceeded or receded.

methods.name: onCPUThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Notify event when CPU threshold is exceeded or receded.
